action.new_text:
"""Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate inputs
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool) or not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a nonnegative finite float")
    if np.isnan(tau_filter) or np.isinf(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a nonnegative finite float")
    for arr_name, arr in [("logp_with_result", logp_with_result), ("logp_call_only", logp_call_only), ("logp_no_call", logp_no_call)]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{arr_name} must be a 2D numpy array")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
    if logp_with_result.size == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty")
    if (np.any(np.isnan(logp_with_result)) or np.any(np.isinf(logp_with_result)) or
        np.any(np.isnan(logp_call_only)) or np.any(np.isinf(logp_call_only)) or
        np.any(np.isnan(logp_no_call)) or np.any(np.isinf(logp_no_call))):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must contain only finite values")
    if np.any(logp_with_result > 0) or np.any(logp_call_only > 0) or np.any(logp_no_call > 0):
        raise ValueError("Log probabilities must be nonpositive")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized weights for future tokens
    t = np.arange(future_horizon, dtype=float)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = np.sum(raw_weights)
    if weight_sum == 0:
        weights = np.zeros(future_horizon)
    else:
        weights = raw_weights / weight_sum

    # Compute weighted future-token loss
    L_with_result = -np.sum(weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_no_call = -np.sum(weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Compute counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)

    # Compute margin
    margin = L_minus - L_with_result

    # Apply threshold
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
